descriptions.text: Scroll ecosystem stablecoin project Essence Finance is suspected of rugpulled, its stablecoin CHI has fallen by more than 92% to $0.077 in the past 24h, more than $20 million of collateral is suspected to have been removed.

Essence Finance's CHI stablecoin on Scroll depegged in late October 2024 after public reports said more than $20 million of collateral had been removed from multisig-controlled reserve contracts. A small multisig controlled the collateral backing CHI, and the reserve model depended on that key set to preserve redeemability. Once collateral was reportedly moved out and redemptions were constrained, the 1:1 backing assumption failed. No verified contract bug or incident transaction hash was established in the available record.
